label: prf:observability-q-independent
title: Proof of observability q independent
html:
Proof. The space \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathbf{C}}(\mathbf{1}, \mathrm{Ad}(A)) is computed in the category \mathbf{C}, which is defined independently of q. The substrate parameter q determines only the differential d_q on \Omega^\bullet(A); it does not modify the objects, morphisms, tensor product, or braiding of \mathbf{C}. The adjoint object \mathrm{Ad}(A) is defined via the conjugation action a \mapsto S(a_{(1)})xa_{(2)}, which involves only the Hopf structure (\mu, \Delta, S) — none of which depends on q.

The subscript \mathbf{C}_q in the notation \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathbf{C}_q} refers to the category equipped with the differential d_q. But \mathrm{Hom}(\mathbf{1}, \mathrm{Ad}(A)) involves no differential — it is a morphism space in the underlying monoidal category, which is the same for all q.

Corollary. The QOU axioms (observability, measurability, volume constraint) are properties of the substrate line bundle base (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau), not of any particular fibre q \in \mathbb{G}_m. They hold uniformly over \mathbb{G}_m, including at the torsion point q = 1 and at all roots of unity.
